title: Cartwheel Retail opportunity sandbox
content:
Goal: land a 3 month pilot with Cartwheel Retail (omnichannel merch + personalization).

Quick context / thesis:
- Cartwheel is mid-market chain (~120 stores + e-commerce). heavy personalization + loyalty program. report: slow search + erratic recs, CS load spikes after price promos.
- Hypothesis: embeddings for product search + cross-sell reranking could reduce time-to-purchase and lower returns. Redwood value prop: predictable latency for search, lower p95 tail than their current hosted embedding service, private deployment option for PII/loyalty data.

Stakeholders (mapped by LinkedIn + CTAs):
- VP Product: Rachel Moore (primary economic buyer) — worried about revenue impact and roadmap velocity
- Dir. Engineering: Andre Kaur (integration + infra constraints) — cares about network/data residency and CICD effort
- Head of Personalization: Omar Singh (end user of model outputs) — cares about quality and evals, A/B test support
- Ops/CS lead: Naomi Park (observability for regressions)

Initial discovery notes (what we need to confirm):
- Current embedding provider + model size (in-house? FAISS? Elastic? SaaS?)
- Typical query volume (QPS peaks during promos) and acceptable latency SLO (p50/p95 targets)
- Data sensitivity: do they consider SKU descriptions + user behavior PII? (likely yes for loyalty ids)
- Existing pipelines: are feature vectors computed offline / online? where to hook in?

Open questions to ask on first call:
- "How do you measure success for search/personalization? DPR / conversion lift?"
- "What's your current infra for embeddings (hosted vendor, self-hosted vector DB)?"
- "Do you have compliance/regulatory constraints that require private networking or customer-managed keys?"

Draft outbound sequence (short, can iterate):
1) Email 1 (value + one-liner):
   Subject: cut search latency + lift conversions at Cartwheel
   Body: Hi Rachel — quick note: we help retailers reduce product find-time and improve recs by running production-grade embeddings + reranking with predictable p95 tail and clear cost controls. Can I share a 10‑min note on a small pilot that uses your SKU+behavior logs?
2) Follow-up (2 days): add customer anecdote + ask for intro to engineering contact
3) LinkedIn connect + one-line note referencing promo spike problem
4) Call / calendar request with suggested agenda (15 min): "current stack, targets, low-risk pilot design"

Call agenda (15 min):
- 2 min intros
- 3 min us: what we ship (hosted + dedicated + private) and why teams pick Redwood for predictable inference economics
- 6 min discovery: traffic, latency SLOs, current stack, data sensitivity, A/B metrics
- 3 min next steps: propose pilot (3 months, one service line: product search embeddings + reranker)

Pilot sketch (low friction):
- Phase A (2–4 weeks): ingest a sample (anonymized) SKU + clickstream dump; run offline embedding evals and precision@K vs baseline; share quality report + cost projection.
- Phase B (4–8 weeks): shadow deploy for search endpoint (route a % of queries through Redwood hosted/dedicated) and measure CTR / latencies (p50/p95).
- Phase C (remaining): full pilot with canary rollout and rollback policy; readiness checklist (observability hooks + synthetic tests).

Success metrics to propose explicitly:
- delta conversion uplift (week over week) 
- decrease in mean time to result (ms) and p95 latency < target (ask them)
- reduction in support tickets for search-related complaints

Technical notes for Andre (pre-call):
- Redwood can run embeddings on customer data in a VPC/private deployment with KMS integration (customer-managed keys).
- Runtime supports continuous batching; you can control batch windows to balance cost/latency.
- Integration points: ingestion via S3 / streaming, or push vectors through API. Offers prefix/KV caching for commons queries.

Common objections + counterpoints (quick bullets):
- "We already have FAISS / in-house vectors" -> A: fair — ask about maintenance cost + scale. Offer an A/B against their in-house system focusing on tail latency and operational overhead.
- "We can’t move loyalty PII off our VPC" -> A: propose a Private deployment with customer-managed keys and network peering. Share SOC2 + audit options.
- "Cost concerns" -> A: show Optimize features: batching configs, quantization suggestions for embeddings, and cost forecast from Phase A sample. Emphasize measurable ROI hypothesis.
- "Don’t want vendor lock" -> A: emphasize model/catalog openness and ability to pin versions + export logs.

Draft email variant for Andre (more technical):
Subject: quick note on low-friction search pilot (Cartwheel)
Body: Andre — Maya here (Redwood). We run inference runtimes that prioritize p95 latency and deterministic throughput for embedding-powered search. Minimal integration: deliver sample vectors via S3 or push event stream; we’ll run an offline eval and show delta vs your baseline. Can we do 20–30 min next week?

Meeting prep checklist (internal):
- bring one pager: 1) pilot scope, 2) sample data requirements, 3) timeline + success metrics
- bring infra playbook for Private deployment (networking checklist)
- have cost ballpark model for their approximate QPS (need to estimate after discovery)

To-dos / follow-ups after first call:
- [ ] Send tailored one-pager + sample data template (Maya)
- [ ] Request anonymized clickstream + SKU sample (Andre)
- [ ] Run quick cost sketch (Jordan)
- [ ] Draft SOW template for 3-month pilot (Sofia)

Notes from last outreach attempts (raw):
- LI message to Rachel got no reply — ping from Jordan might help if framed as "quick idea from a peer retailer"
- internal ref: we have a contact at Replenish (competitor) who saw 6–8% uplift from embeddings->rerank in staged rollout (use as anecdote but avoid overly specific numbers until NDA)

Risk flags / sensitivity:
- Large promo events (Black Friday) are their make-or-break weeks; need strong rollback and fallback policies.
- They likely use a third-party CDN and edge caching — latency improvements must be measurable end-to-end, not just model-side.

Sticky notes / scraps to keep:
- Slack opener: "Hey Rachel — small idea to reduce search returns during promo lifts — 10 min?"
- Phone script snippet: "We help teams reduce time-to-purchase by making search results more relevant, with sub-100ms p95 on typical queries. Curious if we can show a quick before/after?"
- KPI ask phrasing: "What's a win for you in 90 days? revenue lift, search CTR, or support ticket volume?"

End of notes — rough, will iterate after 1st call.
